text_block_list.text:
In the trainer's office.
Ines Fujin had been on the phone with someone for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Yeah... but Mom,
if Su-chan and the others are saying so...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it to me. ...Okay?
No, it's fine! See ya!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Now then, Trainer! I have a favor to ask!

Race day. Sitting neatly side by side on the waiting room chairs
were twin Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You two! Even if Big Sis isn't around,
make sure to always listen to Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!
choice_data_list: That's a good answer, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

Before her debut race, Ines Fujin had
asked me to look after her younger sisters
who were coming to watch the race.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
For bringing those two here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It coincided with Mom's hospital visit... But both of them had been saying for so long that they really wanted to go watch the race.
choice_data_list: Don't worry, just focus on the race.
It's okay, just focus on the race

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! Aha,
then I'll leave it to you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's about time for the paddock.
I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, wait up~! Lou and Sue
have something important to do for Big Sis!
...Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: Spin right round, then pat-pat!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text: Pop! Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
A "Go for it, Big Sis!" dance~!!
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! Wah...!
Thank you, Su-chan, Lu-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, I'm bursting with energy now!
As a thank-you, I'm gonna gift you both
my first-place victory!
Parting ways with Ines Fuujin, I took the twins' little hands and guided them toward the spectator seats.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~... So this is Nakayama Racecourse...
It feels totally different from seeing it on TV~.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text: Not a lot of people around, either.
choice_data_list: Because what's next is your debut race.

text_block_list.text:
The Nakayama Racecourse they know is likely
the one from the "Arima Kinen" or the "Satsuki Sho."

"Right now, the grandstands are filled only with
race officials and seasoned fans.
The atmosphere is... quite different from a festival mood."

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Is that so~
choice_data_list: Was it not what you were expecting?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh, we're really looking forward to it!
I mean, you're running in a race, Big Sis, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister loves running~!
And I love that about her~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: Right?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! So let's give Big Sis
lots and lots of support, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*... *exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Don't be nervous, don't be nervous...!
Remember what Trainer told you...!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
There aren't many spectators, but it's only the beginning.
Once I put up some results, I'll be popular too...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (—I can hear so many different voices.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (The voices of the Umamusume running in the same race, and the cheers of the fans waiting past the paddock.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... Exhaaale...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Is this... the announcement?
They must be using really good speakers.
I can hear the paddock from all the way over here.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if my number's already
up there on the electric board?)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This is the real deal. This is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ladies and gentlemen, feast your eyes on the valiant debuts
of the Umamusume taking the turf today!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series...!
